title: Call-Class Rate Note: After-Hours Visit Fee on Harbison Labor-Only Protection Contracts
content:
**Rate rule.** For the claim service fee on a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, the after-hours visit fee is worked out from the visit fee by the call class of the service call, as recorded under Repair and Emergency Service Calls together with that call class's labor multiplier and its listed after-hours premium.

| Call class of the service call | After-hours visit fee |
|---|---|
| Overnight Emergency Service Call or Holiday Emergency Service Call | the visit fee multiplied by that call class's labor multiplier |
| Evening Service Call or Weekend Service Call | the visit fee plus 0.25 of that call class's listed after-hours premium, the addition made only where the visit fee is above zero |
| any other call class | the visit fee unchanged |

The visit fee is the tier's claim service fee where at least one claim on the call was approved or partially approved, and zero otherwise.

**Worked figures (hypothetical; the $80.00 visit fee, the 1.5 multiplier and the $100.00 premium are illustrative figures).**

| Call class | Visit fee | After-hours visit fee |
|---|---|---|
| Holiday Emergency Service Call, multiplier 1.5 | $80.00 | $80.00 multiplied by 1.5, that is $120.00 |
| Weekend Service Call, listed premium $100.00 | $80.00 | $80.00 plus 0.25 of $100.00, that is $105.00 |
| Weekend Service Call, listed premium $100.00 | zero (all claims denied) | zero — nothing is added |
| Standard Service Call | $80.00 | $80.00 |
